scope: Authoritative source-based context snapshot and explicit canonical chat controls; synthetic controlled tests and actual browser, not model or human semantic approval

api.snapshot: Authenticated GET /api/v1/conversation/speaker; same read transaction revision+latest user cursor+bounded source restoration; metadata only, no mutation/model/tool
api.watch: Opt-in context_cursor query on existing conversation/changes. Legacy query still exactly instance_id/revision and response2fields. Extended response only adds nonnegative integer context_cursor, no actor text. Same shared watch limit/one lazy monitor.
api.control: UI submits separate fixed canonical user turn via existing /turns: role=我来扮演一个虚构角色。; real=回到现实。; no new public mutation or implicit action grant

evidence: Raw HTTP/SSE and metadata/DB state, per-source SHA, browser steps/screenshots, timings observational; fixture mode not GPU quality
